newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-UDINESE SIGN WALEM FROM ANDERLECHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UDINESE SIGN WALEM FROM ANDERLECHT.

text.p: Italian serie A club Udinese have signed Belgium midfielder Johann Walem from Anderlecht on a three-year contract.
"I'm happy to be at Udinese which I chose ahead of other teams," Walem said at the start of three days at the club to meet players and officials.
Walem, capped eight times, joins former Coventry full-back and compatriot Regis Genaux at the north-eastern club.
Udinese, who have German international Oliver Bierhoff and Dane Thomas Helveg on their books, are 12th in the league.
